title: Regional Operations Director
text:
At Elite Sports Clubs, we believe great clubs start with great people, plenty of energy, and a culture that makes work feel a lot more like fun. We're looking for a Regional Operations Director to lead housekeeping, club cleanliness, and operational excellence across multiple locations while ensuring every member enjoys a first-class experience. This role also oversees the planning, setup, execution, and teardown of large-scale club events, helping bring everything from member socials to community events to life. If you're a hands-on leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment, loves building strong teams, and takes pride in creating exceptional spaces and experiences, we'd love to meet you.
